headline: Last Dance
caption:
Niko Price got the send-off the UFC never gave him in Seattle 🔥
Retire or stay? 👇

Price stopped Leon Shahbazyan with ground and pound in Round 1 at UFC Vegas 122 in what was billed as his retirement fight. Back in March he lost to Michael Chiesa on the night Chiesa retired and got no farewell of his own. UFC news.

Should he hang them up?
question: Retire or stay?

v2.story: Snubbed at his first farewell, Price gets a Round 1 TKO in his retirement fight.
v2.question: Retire or stay?
